_b602.draftText:
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE

Lumio launches the Lumio Kettle

Portland, 12 May 2026. Lumio today launches the Lumio Kettle, the only kettle that will transform every kitchen. It boils one litre of water in about four minutes. The recommended price is USD 59.

Lumio is one of several new companies selling compact kitchen appliances.
